title: Loaded Instant Ramen
intro: A guilty indulgence: a packet of instant ramen, upgraded with chilli oil, garlic, mushrooms and capsicum.
method: 1 packet instant ramen as per your preference, i used samyang hot chicken flavour
caption:
let’s make instant ramen! 
guilty indulgence

Nutrition: 
C: 100 | F: 25 | P: 18
Calories: 691 per serve 
Serves 1 or 2 if sharing :) 

Ingredients
1/2 tsp chilli oil
1 tsp minced garlic
1 onion, finely sliced
1/2 green capsicum, sliced
100 grams button mushroom, sliced 
1 packet instant ramen as per your preference, i used samyang hot chicken flavour 
1 egg
1 tsp chilli crisp
